metadata.methods_description: Patients with head and neck cancer pain underwent stereotactic focused ultrasound mesencephalotomy. Neurophysiological monitoring was performed using EEG during the procedure. Structural MRI imaging was acquired as part of the clinical protocol. Data were converted to BIDS format using standardized tools and organized with HED (Hierarchical Event Descriptors) version 8.1.0 for event annotation. Complete methodological details including subject characteristics, inclusion/exclusion criteria, apparatus specifications, task organization, and data quality assessment are provided in the README.md file.
